blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution on Monday presented purported Google Maps views of Vice President Sara Duterte’s property in Matina Crossing, Davao City, as it questioned whether the property was properly declared in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN). During Day 40 of the Duterte impeachment trial, prosecution counsel Benjamin Tolosa Jr. first showed a satellite view of the location and asked defense witness Jamie Adalin, City assessor from Davao City, to identify whether the pinned location points to the same property in question. “Yes, you’re correct Sir,” Adalin said.
